subject: CARSI's continuing-education courses for restoration technicians
category_default_avoided: Training-provider posts in this space default to a smiling technician on a stock jobsite with a certification badge lock-up; no variation uses a person, a badge, or a photograph.
axis_constraint: carsi.ts declares only Lora (display) + Inter (body), and SKILL.md §10 bans Inter as display type, so all three variations set display in Lora. The typeface-class axis of §4 cannot vary for a two-family brand. Collision judged on colour strategy, layout system and cultural reference only.

variations.name: calibration-field

tokens.signature: A 13x9 field of hairline tally marks, irregularly weighted — the reading grid as the whole upper field

variations.why: Strongest scroll-stopper and the only board whose ground is blue, but the hook runs to four lines
variations.revision: Hook cut from four lines to two ('Continuing education for technicians'); eyebrow reduced to CARSI so the category is not stated twice; [NEEDS APPROVAL] marker moved off the CTA eye-line to a quiet line beneath it, at full opacity so it clears the 4.5:1 floor (4.88:1).

variations.name: course-record
variations.hook: Every reading has a method behind it

tokens.signature: A four-row ruled ledger that reads as an actual course record, the withheld figure sitting in it as a row rather than a hero

variations.why: Highest contrast on the board, the most patient and least sensational hook, and the only layout that is already a template — the four rows parameterise for a SERIES run

variations.name: ma-minimal

tokens.signature: A single blue hairline set to the headline measure, the only mark on the field

variations.why: Calmest and most on-voice, but names the least and leaves a large lower void

critique.stage_2: independent-context review via the design-critic subagent (same model, isolated context — NOT cross-vendor)
critique.collision_note: First pass failed: editorial-print and ma-minimal shared colour strategy AND layout system. v1 was redesigned onto a blue ground with a repeating-mark field to break it.

consumer: docs/marketing-agency/design-runs/README.md index row. No design_runs table is applied and no Linear task was created (Linear MCP not authorised).

founder_decision.reason: v2's signature was the CEC-hours numeral as graphic; with facts_approved empty the numeral rendered [NEEDS APPROVAL] and the direction lost its hero element, leaving a void. v1's central idea is a graphic rather than a fact, so it survives an empty claims register.
founder_decision.claim_resolution: The [NEEDS APPROVAL: hours per course] element was removed, not approved. The founder confirmed CEC hours are an internal number only, so it is out of scope for marketing surfaces permanently — recorded as a standing prohibition in carsi.claims.md rather than as a candidate awaiting sign-off.

template.fidelity: Template output is byte-identical to the locked board (cmp, 1080x1440).
